title: Ulyana and the Glasshouse
author: Freya Ravensworth
blurb: Xanthe Whitlock, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
